qs.q: During an anatomical dissection of the gluteal region, the gluteus maximus is reflected. Which thick fascial structure does it share an aponeurotic origin with?
qs.e: Gluteus maximus arises partly from the posterior aspect of the thoracolumbar fascia and the iliac crest.
